compounding_issues: Every session failed identically at the same boundary (Claude OAuth session expired, 0 tokens, exit code 1) — so no code ever accumulated and no early decision could constrain later sessions; the 'progression' is five empty shells on one seed commit

The claude_cli backend's dead OAuth session (the documented 'Claude OAuth clearing' failure mode) was never detected or recovered across sessions — the same auth error repeats verbatim in sessions 1-5

The 146-line seed carries latent bugs that would have compounded had any session run (create_task persists status 'done' but returns 'pending'; duplicate get_task/fetch_task aliases; unused _notify_admin/_legacy_format_date stubs)
key_decisions: Story plan design: greenfield -> JWT auth -> async email notifications -> Repository-pattern refactor -> rate limiting/pagination — a textbook dependency-ordered progression that never got executed
Seed architecture: single-file Flask app with direct sqlite3 access (get_db/init_db, row_factory) chosen as the baseline the Repository refactor in session 4 was meant to improve
Cell configuration: claude-sonnet-5 under early_degrade perturbation — but the run never reached the model, dying at the auth gate before any agent decision occurred
story_review.trajectory_description: The quality arc is flat at zero: the intended arc (clean greenfield -> feature -> integration -> refactor -> cross-cutting, with session 4's Repository pattern depending on the coupling introduced in sessions 1-3) is a sound design on paper, but none of it materialized. Each of the five sessions produced 0 tokens, 0 lines of code, and 0 test coverage in 1.3-1.7s of wall time, with identical 'Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired' transcripts. Code line count stays pinned at the seed's 146 lines (code_lines: 146 in every session) and test_executed_success is false. This is an infrastructure failure masquerading as a story: the claude_cli OAuth session was dead before the first session and was never refreshed, so the review cannot assess any quality arc — only its absence.
story_review.summary: The five-session task_manager_api story is a well-designed progression that was never executed — every session died at the Claude OAuth boundary with zero code produced, leaving only an unmodified seed commit and five empty transcript stubs.
